title: She Danced Through Morning Sickness and Told No One: Samantha Ruth Prabhu Is Having a Baby
excerpt: A box-office smash, a pregnancy reveal, and a sequel already confirmed — Samantha is living her most radiant chapter yet
body:
Here is the scene: a packed success meet in Hyderabad. **Samantha Ruth Prabhu** is seated next to her husband, **Raj Nidimoru** — one half of the Raj & DK duo that gave India *The Family Man*. She is wearing the kind of smile that has nothing to do with cameras. And then, almost casually, she says it.

> "After Maa Inti Bangaaram, I will have to take a small gap, given my condition. I'll have to take maternity leave. But I am very, very happy, and after that, I'll be back with another film for my fans."

The room erupted. Fans had been piecing it together for days — a subtle baby bump spotted at an outing in Mumbai, a green satin dress at the airport that did not quite conceal what everyone was whispering about. But hearing it from Samantha herself, glowing and unhurried, with Raj beside her — that was the moment.

The couple is expecting their first child together in **December 2026**.

## The Secret She Kept on Set

What makes this story extraordinary is what came next. Director **Nandini Reddy** revealed in an interview that Samantha had shot some of the most physically demanding scenes in **Maa Inti Bangaaram** while already in her first trimester — and battling severe morning sickness.

The filmmaker had no idea. When Samantha appeared unwell during the shoot of the high-energy wedding track *Thassadiya*, the crew assumed it was a fever. The next day, Nandini asked if she was feeling better.

"At first, she didn't say anything. A minute later, she said, actually, I'm carrying and suffering from morning sickness," Nandini recalled. "From there, we took care during the rest of the shoot. Luckily, the action portions were already shot."

Let that sink in. One of the most electrifying dance sequences in a film this year was performed by a woman fighting nausea between takes and telling absolutely nobody. That is not just professionalism — it is a kind of quiet ferocity that defines Samantha's entire career.

## The Comeback Before the Break

The timing of everything is almost too cinematic. After two years of being largely homebound — battling myositis, stepping away from the spotlight, enduring a very public divorce from **Naga Chaitanya** and the tabloid cruelty that followed — Samantha returned with *Maa Inti Bangaaram* and watched it become a phenomenon.

The Telugu-language action-comedy-drama, directed by Nandini Reddy and created by Raj Nidimoru, has grossed over **₹59 crore worldwide** and counting. It is powered by Samantha in full action-hero mode — a role her husband specifically designed to flip the template of male-led masala cinema and put a woman at its centre.

At the film's success celebration in Vizag, she let the emotion show: "In the last three years, I was homebound for two years, battling a health crisis. You have embraced Maa Inti Bangaaram like your own. The number of women in theatres, the number of grannies and kids watching our movie, whistling, enjoying... the feeling is indescribable."

And then, almost in the same breath: Raj confirmed **Maa Inti Bangaaram 2** is happening. Samantha will return after her maternity break to lead the sequel.

## A Love Story Written Quietly

Samantha and Raj Nidimoru found each other on the sets of *The Family Man Season 2*, where she played the unforgettable Raji — a performance that pivoted her career from romantic leads to something far more interesting. They dated privately, married on **December 1, 2025**, in a Bhuta Shuddhi Vivaha ceremony at the Linga Bhairavi Temple in the Isha Yoga Centre, Coimbatore. Intimate, spiritual, no circus.

She has spoken about trusting his judgment almost entirely — calling him remarkably grounded for someone in the film industry. He, in turn, has built a character and a franchise around her strengths. It is the kind of partnership that produces both good cinema and, apparently, very good news.

## Where NRIs Can Watch

For diaspora audiences who have followed Samantha from *Ye Maaya Chesave* through *Rangasthalam* to *The Family Man* and *Oo Antava*, *Maa Inti Bangaaram* is currently running in theatres across the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and the Gulf. A streaming date has not been announced, but given its box-office trajectory, an OTT window is likely within six to eight weeks.

For now, the headline is simpler: Samantha Ruth Prabhu, 39, at the absolute peak of her powers, is about to become a mother. The break will be short. The sequel is waiting.

And if she can dance through morning sickness without a single person noticing, there is genuinely nothing this woman cannot do.
